test_series_overrides.name: Punjab PCS (PPSC) Chapterwise Series
test_series_overrides.summary: Chapterwise Punjab GK, history, geography, economy and polity in the statement-based format PPSC now sets.

test_series_overrides.name: PSSSB Combined Recruitment Series
test_series_overrides.summary: Clerk, VDO and technical posts: Punjab awareness, Punjabi language, maths and reasoning, chapter by chapter.

test_series_overrides.name: Punjab Patwari Chapterwise Series
test_series_overrides.summary: Revenue-department oriented: Punjab land and geography, awareness, maths, reasoning.

test_series_overrides.name: Punjab Police Constable & SI Series
test_series_overrides.summary: Constable and Sub-Inspector pattern with Punjab-heavy general awareness.

test_series_overrides.name: Master Cadre Punjabi Series
test_series_overrides.summary: The 150 question Punjabi subject paper: ਸਾਹਿਤ ਦਾ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ, ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਤੇ ਸੂਫ਼ੀ ਕਾਵਿ, ਕਿੱਸਾ, ਗਲਪ, ਨਾਟਕ, ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਵਿਗਿਆਨ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਆਕਰਨ।

test_series_overrides.name: Master Cadre English Series
test_series_overrides.summary: The 150 question English subject paper: grammar, vocabulary, comprehension, phonetics and the British and Indian literary periods.

test_series_overrides.name: Master Cadre Hindi Series
test_series_overrides.summary: हिंदी विषय का 150 प्रश्नों वाला स्नातक स्तरीय पेपर — व्याकरण के साथ आदिकाल, भक्तिकाल, रीतिकाल, आधुनिक काव्य, गद्य विधाएँ, काव्यशास्त्र, हिंदी भाषा का विकास और हिंदी शिक्षण विधियाँ।

test_series_overrides.name: Master Cadre Mathematics Series
test_series_overrides.summary: The 150 question Mathematics paper at graduation level: matrices and determinants, set theory, sequences and series, binomial theorem, limits, continuity, derivatives, integrals, differential equations, straight lines, conic sections, three dimensional geometry, complex numbers, trigonometry, permutations and combinations, statistics, probability and linear programming.

test_series_overrides.name: Master Cadre Science Series
test_series_overrides.summary: The 150 question Science subject paper covering physics, chemistry and biology at graduation depth, with the school pedagogy base.

test_series_overrides.name: Master Cadre Social Science Series
test_series_overrides.summary: The 150 question Social Science subject paper: history, geography, political science and economics at graduation depth.

test_series_overrides.name: Master Cadre Physical Education (DPE) Series
test_series_overrides.summary: The 150 question DPE subject paper: foundations of physical education, fitness components, training principles, anatomy and physiology, sports injuries, rules of major games and sports awards.

test_series_overrides.name: Master Cadre Music Series
test_series_overrides.summary: The 150 question Music subject paper: swara and saptak, raga structure and jati, taal and laya, khayal and dhrupad, instrument classification, the history of Indian music and notation and teaching method.

test_series_overrides.name: PSTET and TET Art and Craft Series
test_series_overrides.summary: Art and Craft as the Paper II subject option in PSTET: elements and principles of art, colour theory, perspective, Indian painting traditions, folk crafts and craft pedagogy.

test_series_overrides.name: Master & Lecturer Cadre Punjabi Qualifying Paper
test_series_overrides.summary: The compulsory 50 mark matric level Punjabi paper every Master Cadre and Lecturer Cadre candidate must clear, whatever the main subject.

test_series_overrides.name: Punjab ETT Cadre Paper A — Punjabi (Qualifying)
test_series_overrides.summary: The 100 question Punjabi qualifying paper, exactly the six ERB sections: ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਤੇ ਉਪਭਾਸ਼ਾ, ਲਿਪੀ ਤੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ, ਧੁਨੀ ਵਿਗਿਆਨ, ਸ਼ਬਦ ਬੋਧ ਤੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਬਣਤਰ, ਸ਼ਬਦਾਵਲੀ ਤੇ ਵਾਕ ਦੀ ਵੰਡ, ਅਤੇ ਵਿਆਕਰਨ ਜਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਨਾਰਥਕ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਤੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਜੋੜ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹਨ। Clear this to reach Paper B.
